_meta.note: The organisation's mailbox of messages that belong to no case yet: the intake triage queue (outcome inbox or quarantined, sleeping items left out), read through dossiq's own /api/intake/triage, which holds the intake-role check. The generic object endpoint would apply the register's permissions instead and show the originals to anyone the register lets read, so the list is an endpoint source (`entitySource: endpoint`) over that route and never the schema's own endpoint. Each row carries the case its subject quotes (`suggestion`, CaseMatchSuggestion) and the channel it came in on (`channel`, `email` for the mailbox; TriageChannel). The channel is a filter of the endpoint (`searchFields.channel`, so `?channel=portal` narrows the list on the server) and the answer counts every channel of the lens in `channels`, the facet the endpoint counts (`sourceConfig.facets`, nextcloud-vue feat/endpoint-facet-select); `picker: false` keeps it out of the toolbar, because the board filters the channel in the Filter panel only; a channel id without a label shows as its id. The default lens is every channel, which the Active line names `Channel: all` (board DqPostvak). The endpoint source (nextcloud-vue #1750) and the `actions` cell widget are nextcloud-vue keys in progress (L25); until they land the page lists nothing rather than the wrong rows.

sidebar._note: DqPostvak: the Filter button opens the index side panel. Its one filter is the channel the triage endpoint already takes (`sourceConfig.searchFields.channel`), so the panel narrows the server's answer rather than the rows on screen.

actions._note: capability-rows-say-the-whole-capability 2.7 (REQ-CRS-18): file the message on any case the intake worker picks, not only the one its subject suggests. The dialog posts to the intake log's file-on-case route, which holds the intake role, the read check on the picked case and the required reason; a filed message has outcome case and so leaves this queue, which lists inbox and quarantined messages only.
